headline: Fines proposed for false "eco" and "bio" labels on products in Kyrgyzstan
summary: Kyrgyzstan is considering fines for using 'eco', 'bio', 'organic' and 'environmentally clean' labels on goods whose organic status is not certified. The proposal targets product labelling.
why: Labelling rules affect how food and consumer goods can be marketed and what compliance costs producers and retailers face.
original_headline: За фальшивые «эко» и «био» на продуктах в Кыргызстане хотят штрафовать
